title: PhysicalIlluminanceAndTemporalFlickerCommissioningSchema
description: Bifurcated commissioning schema separating static physical illuminance from high-frequency temporal light modulation (flicker), resolving the sensor capability gap in prior drafts.
instrumentation_separation_mandate: Standard digital lux meters (sampling at 1-2 Hz) CANNOT measure optical flicker index or temporal modulation frequencies >= 1000 Hz. Gate C7 enforces TWO distinct measurement paths with dedicated calibrated instruments.

path_1_static_physical_illuminance.purpose: Verify steady-state photopic light level across the vehicle corridor and secondary cross-aisle.

instrument_requirements.instrument_type: Class B DIN 5032-7 Precision Lux Meter
instrument_requirements.spectral_response: CIE photopic spectral luminous efficiency V(lambda)

path_2_temporal_light_modulation_flicker.purpose: Verify absence of optical flicker or rolling-shutter CMOS sensor banding artifacts from warehouse LED drivers.
path_2_temporal_light_modulation_flicker.acceptance_target: flicker_index <= 0.05 AND modulation_frequency >= 1000.0 Hz (conforming to IEEE 1789 recommended practices)

instrument_requirements.instrument_type: High-Frequency Photodiode Sensor with Oscilloscope OR Dedicated Optical Flicker Spectroradiometer
example_models: Thorlabs PDA36A2 Amplified Photodetector + Keysight DSOX1204G Oscilloscope

path_2_temporal_light_modulation_flicker.status_explanation: Prior draft listed Testo 540 which CANNOT measure high-frequency flicker. Path 2 requires dedicated high-frequency photometer hardware. Gate C7 CANNOT achieve GATE_PASS until Path 2 hardware is deployed and measured.

gate_c7_acceptance_rule.evaluation_logic: Gate C7 PASS requires BOTH Path 1 (300 lux <= mean <= 400 lux) == PASS AND Path 2 (flicker_index <= 0.05 and freq >= 1000 Hz) == PASS. If Path 2 instrument is unverified, Gate C7 remains UNVERIFIED_PENDING_PHYSICAL_COMMISSIONING.
